items.title: Early Drafts and Process Notes Prove Little to Nothing About Authors’ AI Use
items.excerpt: An author was dropped by her agent over suspected AI use despite showing 11 drafts and notes. But since writers can use AI throughout revision, process documents may prove less than they hope.

items.title: 'Keep it human': James McAvoy describes using AI for audio as 'food without calories'
items.excerpt: Actor, and winner of the 2026 British Audio Award for Best Performance: Narrator for his work on JD Kirk’s Recall (Audible Originals), James McAvoy has called for the industry to reject the use of AI in audio and “keep it human”.

items.title: Sarah Wynn-Williams warns 'AI witch hunts' are unsustainable in publishing
items.excerpt: Careless People (Pan Macmillan) author Sarah Wynn-Williams has warned that what she described as “Pangram witch hunts” are unsustainable, calling for greater dialogue between authors, publishers, governments and the technology industry over the use of artificial intelligence.

items.title: Minister for AI opens Winter Hay Festival with keynote on government's approach
items.excerpt: The government’s Minister for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Kanishka Narayan laid out his approach and current perspective on AI in his keynote speech, opening Hay Festival’s Winter Weekend on Thursday 26th November 2026.

items.title: “On n'est pas des imprimeurs” : le ras-le-bol d'un éditeur
items.excerpt: 2500 manuscrits en attente, 80 nouveaux chaque semaine, et des textes générés par intelligence artificielle qui viennent grossir la pile. Aux Forges de Vulcain, la boîte déborde. David Meulemans a donc tranché : à partir du 1er décembre, les manuscrits ne seront plus acceptés pendant quatre mois. « On n'est pas des imprimeurs », résume-t-il auprès d'ActuaLitté.

items.title: Just-in-Time Synthesis: A New Approach to an Old Genre
items.excerpt: A commissioned review article and a just-in-time generated overview answer the same reader need; what differs is how each is made and whether a reader can tell enough about it to trust it.​​​​
